Unreal Engine

Unreal Engine provides real-time 3D rendering, interaction and simulation for immersive experiences.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Import an engineering scene

Use the selected model, asset hierarchy and scale. In the intended Unreal Engine preview, import an engineering scene; the visible result is a composed scene with geometry and camera framing visible. Review object identity, silhouette and missing assets before accepting or exporting it.

Build an interactive review

Start from the approved scene state, materials and motion intent. In the intended Unreal Engine preview, build an interactive review; the visible result is a lighting, animation or effects preview with changed controls exposed. Review timing, material response, collisions and visual continuity before accepting or exporting it.

Package a real-time experience

Begin with the reviewed cameras, render settings and delivery format. In the intended Unreal Engine preview, package a real-time experience; the visible result is a bounded presentation sequence or image comparison. Review frame content, colour, legibility and output specification before accepting or exporting it.
